description: Estimates the Cyprus unemployment benefit using statutory percentage-point dependant additions and a capped earnings-related supplement, and separately assesses entitlement when qualifying facts are supplied. Use to estimate the conditional Cyprus unemployment benefit amount and separately assess entitlement. The basic rate is 60%; an eligible spouse adds 20 percentage points and up to two other dependants add 10 each. Without a spouse increase, the first other dependant adds 20 points and the next two add 10 each, except that spouse earnings/benefit exclusion permits 10 each for at most two. Ask the reason or report the unresolved range; the earnings-related supplement is 50% of supplementary insurance earnings, capped at one weekly basic insurable earning. Require the claim date, relevant-year insurable earnings and dependants to estimate an amount. Ask for qualifying insurance history, employee status, unemployment registration and availability for work before claiming entitlement; when those facts are missing, state that entitlement is undetermined and ask each missing follow-up question. Do not infer those facts from annual earnings.

actualBasicInsurancePoints.description: Actual paid basic insurance points accumulated by claim date; 0.5 required for entitlement.

annualGrossEarnings.description: Actual gross insurable earnings in EUR for the contribution year selected by applicationDate.

capableAndAvailableForWork.description: Whether capable of and available for work during the claim.

dependentChildren.description: Actual number of dependent children or other dependants; ask if unknown (benefit calculation caps at 3).

dependentSpouse.description: Whether the claimant has a dependent spouse not in paid work; ask if unknown.

isEmployee.description: Whether the claimant was insured as an employee rather than self-employed.

noSpouseIncreaseReason.description: When no spouse increase is payable, distinguish no spouse/other reason from exclusion due to spouse earnings or benefit. Missing facts produce a conditional lower estimate and a range. Count only eligible dependants, respecting simultaneous claims.

registeredUnemployed.description: Whether registered unemployed with the competent offices.

relevantYearInsurancePoints.description: Actual plus assimilated insurance points in the relevant contribution year; at least 0.39 required.

weeksSinceFirstInsurance.description: Weeks elapsed since first insurance; at least 26 required.

name: calculate_cyprus_unemployment_benefit
